subject: general
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:

**'Cut no ice'**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Have no effect**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Cut no ice"** means to have no influence or effect on someone or something; it implies that the argument or action fails to convince or make an impact. (कोई प्रभाव नहीं डालना)

 
 
• **Example: **His excuses cut no ice with the teacher, and he was still punished for being late.
 
 
 
• **"Effect" **refers to a change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause. (प्रभाव)
 
 
• **Example: **The new policy had a positive effect on the company’s growth.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom **'Cut no ice' **means **'Have no effect'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Have no effect**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Create trouble **(मुसीबत पैदा करना): Refers to causing problems or disturbances.

 
 
• **Example:** His careless actions often create trouble in the team.
 
 
 
• **Be sharp **(तीक्ष्ण होना): Refers to being intellectually quick or alert.
 
 
• **Example: **She is known to be sharp and always finds clever solutions to difficult situations.
 
 
 
• **Stop something** (कुछ रोकना): Refers to bringing something to an end or halting its progress.
 
 
• **Example:** The manager decided to stop the project due to budget constraints.
 
 

182:T7bb,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
